description_target.target_text: Search each candidate panel for any 90° clockwise rotations of the template. Output a one-row strip with cyan(8) under the candidates that contain at least one rotated match and 0 under the rest.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))

    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (split-cols-9 grid)
      (let loop ([c 0] [start 0] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(>= c (cols grid))
               (reverse (if (< start (cols grid))
                            (cons (subgrid grid 0 start (- (rows grid) 1) (- (cols grid) 1)) acc)
                            acc))]
              [(all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c) 9)) (range 0 (rows grid)))
               (let scan ([cc c])
                 (if (and (< cc (cols grid))
                          (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r cc) 9)) (range 0 (rows grid))))
                     (scan (+ cc 1))
                     (loop cc cc
                           (if (< start c)
                               (cons (subgrid grid 0 start (- (rows grid) 1) (- c 1)) acc)
                               acc))))]
              [else (loop (+ c 1) start acc)])))
    (define (crop-nonzero grid)
      (let ((cells (filter (lambda (p)
                             (let ((v (at grid (first p) (second p))))
                               (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 9)))))
                           (grid-positions grid))))
        (if (empty? cells)
            (grid (list 0))
            (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
              (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))))
    (define (rot270 grid) (rotate-cw (rotate-180 grid)))
    (define (transform-code grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rot270 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (flip-lr grid)]
            [(= code 5) (rotate-cw (flip-lr grid))]
            [(= code 6) (rotate-180 (flip-lr grid))]
            [(= code 7) (rot270 (flip-lr grid))]
            [else grid]))
    (define (variant-grids grid mode)
      (cond [(= mode 0) (list grid)]
            [(= mode 1) (list grid (rotate-cw grid) (rotate-180 grid) (rot270 grid))]
            [else (remove-duplicates
                   (list grid (rotate-cw grid) (rotate-180 grid) (rot270 grid)
                         (flip-lr grid) (rotate-cw (flip-lr grid))
                         (rotate-180 (flip-lr grid)) (rot270 (flip-lr grid))))]))
    (define (match-at? board template r c)
      (all? (lambda (p)
              (let ((tv (at template (first p) (second p))))
                (or (= tv 0) (= (at board (+ r (first p)) (+ c (second p))) tv))))
            (grid-positions template)))
    (define (find-matches board template mode)
      (flatmap
       (lambda (t)
         (for*/list ([r (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (rows board) (rows t))))]
                     [c (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (cols board) (cols t))))]
                     #:when (match-at? board t r c))
           (list r c t)))
       (variant-grids template mode)))
    (define (render-board h w cells [color 8])
      (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0)
                   (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w))
                           (remove-duplicates cells))
                   color))
    (define (match-nonzero-cells match)
      (let ((r0 (first match)) (c0 (second match)) (t (third match)))
        (map (lambda (p) (list (+ r0 (first p)) (+ c0 (second p))))
             (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at t (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                     (grid-positions t)))))
    (define (board-union-matches board matches [color 8])
      (render-board (rows board) (cols board) (flatmap match-nonzero-cells matches) color))
    (define (board-copy-matches board matches)
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows board) (cols board) 0)])
                ([p (in-list (remove-duplicates (flatmap match-nonzero-cells matches)))])
        (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (at board (first p) (second p)))))
    (define (border-boxes board matches [color 8])
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows board) (cols board) 0)]) ([m (in-list matches)])
        (let* ((r (first m)) (c (second m)) (t (third m))
               (r2 (+ r (rows t) -1)) (c2 (+ c (cols t) -1)))
          (draw-rect-outline out r c r2 c2 color))))
    (define (strip-mark n idxs [color 8])
      (grid-from-fn 1 n (lambda (r c) (if (member? c idxs) color 0))))
    (define (missing-required board t r c)
      (filter (lambda (p)
                (let ((tv (at t (first p) (second p)))
                      (bv (at board (+ r (first p)) (+ c (second p)))))
                  (and (not (= tv 0)) (not (= tv bv)) (= bv 0))))
              (grid-positions t)))
    (define (required-compatible? board t r c)
      (all? (lambda (p)
              (let ((tv (at t (first p) (second p)))
                    (bv (at board (+ r (first p)) (+ c (second p)))))
                (or (= tv 0) (= tv bv) (= bv 0))))
            (grid-positions t)))
    (define (template-zero-clear? board t r c)
      (all? (lambda (p)
              (or (not (= (at t (first p) (second p)) 0))
                  (= (at board (+ r (first p)) (+ c (second p))) 0)))
            (grid-positions t)))
    (define (near-match? board t r c holes)
      (and (required-compatible? board t r c)
           (template-zero-clear? board t r c)
           (= (length (missing-required board t r c)) holes)))
    (define (exact-or-hole-matches board template mode holes)
      (flatmap
       (lambda (t)
         (for*/list ([r (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (rows board) (rows t))))]
                     [c (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (cols board) (cols t))))]
                     #:when (near-match? board t r c holes))
           (list r c t
                 (map (lambda (p) (list (+ r (first p)) (+ c (second p)) (at t (first p) (second p))))
                      (missing-required board t r c)))))
       (variant-grids template mode)))
    (define (border-clear? board match)
      (let* ((r0 (first match)) (c0 (second match)) (t (third match))
             (r1 (+ r0 (rows t) -1)) (c1 (+ c0 (cols t) -1)))
        (all? (lambda (p)
                (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
                  (or (not (in-bounds? r c (rows board) (cols board)))
                      (and (>= r r0) (<= r r1) (>= c c0) (<= c c1))
                      (= (at board r c) 0))))
              (for*/list ([r (in-range (- r0 1) (+ r1 2))]
                          [c (in-range (- c0 1) (+ c1 2))])
                (list r c)))))
    (define (color-pattern-ok? board template r c)
      (define fwd (make-hash))
      (define rev (make-hash))
      (define ok #t)
      (for* ([rr (in-range (rows template))] [col (in-range (cols template))])
        (when ok
          (define tv (at template rr col))
          (define bv (at board (+ r rr) (+ c col)))
          (cond [(= tv 0) (when (not (= bv 0)) (set! ok #f))]
                [(= bv 0) (set! ok #f)]
                [(and (hash-has-key? fwd tv) (not (= (hash-ref fwd tv) bv))) (set! ok #f)]
                [(and (hash-has-key? rev bv) (not (= (hash-ref rev bv) tv))) (set! ok #f)]
                [else (hash-set! fwd tv bv) (hash-set! rev bv tv)])))
      ok)
    (define (color-pattern-matches board template)
      (for*/list ([r (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (rows board) (rows template))))]
                  [c (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (cols board) (cols template))))]
                  #:when (color-pattern-ok? board template r c))
        (list r c template)))
    (define (dihedral-equiv? a b)
      (let ((bb (crop-nonzero b)))
        (not (eq? (find-first (lambda (v) (equal? v bb)) (variant-grids (crop-nonzero a) 2)) #f))))
    (define (detect-transform-code src tgt)
      (let ((target (crop-nonzero tgt)))
        (let loop ([codes (range 0 8)])
          (cond [(empty? codes) 0]
                [(equal? (transform-code (crop-nonzero src) (first codes)) target) (first codes)]
                [else (loop (rest codes))]))))

    (let* ((panels (split-cols-9 g))
           (template (crop-nonzero (first panels)))
           (cands (rest panels))
           (idxs (map first
                      (filter (lambda (pair) (not (empty? (find-matches (second pair) template 1))))
                              (enumerate-list cands)))))
      (strip-mark (length cands) idxs 8))
  ))
